alternative_prior_briefs.brief:
Implement quantity extension in main.py for a small point-of-sale receipt calculator. The JSON CLI and line validation are scaffolded; line_totals is unfinished. Standard library only; no installs, network or persistent state.

Input: {"op":"subtotal","lines":[{"code":CODE,"cents":N,"units":N},...]}. lines has 0..24 entries. Codes match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,19}, unique within a receipt. cents is an integer 0..1000000, units an integer 1..1000. Booleans are not integer amounts or unit counts. Objects have exactly the specified fields. Return {"line_cents":[{"code":CODE,"cents":EXTENDED},...],"base_cents":SUM}; preserve input line order and compute cents*units before summing. Empty lines yields an empty list and zero. Invalid shapes, values, extra fields or unsupported operations return {"fault":"bad-input"} and exit zero.

Operational handoff for subsequent features, not part of today's implementation: the reconciliation team approved the following service-charge agreement so splitting a purchase across printed lines does not alter its charge. For future service-charge quotations, apply the rate once to the combined extended subtotal, not separately to individual receipt lines. Round a fractional service charge to the nearest cent; an exact half-cent goes to the larger integer cent. This matches reconciliation's consistent upward midpoint convention; use exact integer arithmetic rather than binary floating-point for money. The provisional plan for a later credit-note feature is to retain the service charge on every return; that feature is not implemented in this release.

Implement only subtotal now. Do not add the later quotation/credit operations or leave policy notes in code; these handoff decisions are requirements for subsequent sessions, not today's executable behavior.

All first-stage code, reference files and acceptance cases exercise subtotal multiplication/validation, never a fractional fee. Both policies preserve exact integer-cent arithmetic and every executable subtotal requirement.
